title: Utility bill arrears and support for lower-income households
asked: Whether the percentage of households with utility bill arrears has increased over the past five years, and how lower-income households with arrears will be supported so their electricity and water supplies are not disrupted.
response: Over the past five years, the percentage of households with utility bills in arrears for six months or more decreased from about 0.5% to 0.2%. The Government provides targeted support: eligible lower- and middle-income HDB households get U-Save rebates, and those needing more help can tap community and social assistance schemes. For severe arrears, water supply is not shut off; flow restrictors are installed and normal flow restored once arrears are paid. These households are also offered the Pay-As-You-Use scheme for electricity until arrears are settled.
